title: Entertainers Paradise! $6M Estate with Lagoon Pool
description: Escape to your own private resort at this gated 10,000 sq ft Paradise Valley estate. With 6 bedrooms (4 en-suite), a Dolby surround theater, upstairs lounge, and a 1,200 sq ft game room featuring a Foresight Golf simulator, basketball hoop, gym equipment, and arcade games, there's something for everyone. Outside, enjoy PV's only lagoon-style pool (see Other Things to Note), heated spa, covered daybeds, outdoor dining, fire pit, and plenty of loungers and seating.

Fantastic host and stunning property! Photos cannot do it justice, truly amazing! Ross was very friendly and accommodating. Location is in a great area and very close to the Scottsdale strip if that’s your thing.

We had a fantastic stay at Ross’s place! From the moment we arrived, everything was seamless. Check-in was incredibly easy with clear instructions, and Ross was always quick to respond and very friendly throughout our stay. The home was spotless, well-maintained, and looked exactly like the listing. Everything we needed was provided, and it truly felt like a comfortable home away from home. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
